method: Frontal image ratios calibrated to the shared block footprint, cross-checked against actual 3D shape. Estimates, not a building survey.

front_photo.calculation: 1100 px / 16.8 m = 65.48 px/m. (850-125)/65.48 = 11.07 m apparent cornice height, with perspective/ground uncertainty ~0.6 m. Adopt 11.6 m after comparison to 3D and adjacent cornice levels. First-floor sill (850-580)/65.48 = 4.12 m; adopt 4.3 m. Middle sill (850-353)/65.48 = 7.59 m; adopt 8.05 m after front Street View comparison.

roof_plan.calculation: Projected frontage sqrt(253^2+258^2)=361 px; depth/frontage 193/361=.534. Adopt 16.8*.534=8.98 m depth. Do not use raw ground scale on elevated roofs.
roof_plan.wing_basis: Relative 3D/plan proportions; approximate, may include connected historic rear accommodation.

registration.basis: Existing Occulo affine party boundary, retained exactly to avoid cracks. New range uses same shear values.
registration.limitation: Potential 2–3 m overall registration discrepancy remains to be resolved through a coordinated Occulo/Empire survey; not concealed by moving roads.
